transforms.operation: Slug the English detachment name into the repository entity id.

filters: Seed missing detachments only for supported repository faction directories; existing detachments are matched by this slug.
/id.reason: Detachment ids are deterministic repository slugs, not dump UUIDs.

filters: Seed missing detachments only for supported repository faction directories.
/name.reason: The source-backed detachment seeder copies the English display name.

transforms.operation: Resolve the owning faction keyword name to its repository faction directory.

filters: Seed missing detachments only when publication ownership resolves to a known repository faction directory.
/faction_id.reason: Ownership follows detachment publication ownership; applicability associations do not establish faction_id.

transforms.operation: Slug each dump rule display name to its bare entity id and reconcile against the authored link.

filters: The deprecated singular link is verified against the dump join but never rewritten; new links are written to detachment_rule_ids.
/detachment_rule_id.reason: Deprecated single-rule link. The dump's detachment_rule join confirms or surfaces it for review; it is folded into the authored-link set but is not the write target.

transforms.operation: Slug each dump rule display name to its bare entity id (nameToId), sorted and de-duplicated.

filters: A link is written only when its slug resolves to an ability already authored in the dir's enrichment (an unresolved id would fail integrity; rule prose is authored separately, never minted from the dump).
Authored links that disagree with the dump slug are surfaced for review, never overwritten.
precedence: Existing authored links win; fill only when the detachment has no authored rule link and the dump slug resolves to an authored ability.
/detachment_rule_ids.reason: Structural named-rule → ability links are joined from detachment_rule. PARTIAL: detachments whose rule ability is not yet authored (chiefly the new 11e chapter detachments) are surfaced as an authoring worklist rather than filled, since the ability entity — and its prose — is authored separately.

transforms.operation: Each member is the bare entity id (nameToId) of one dump rule display name.

filters: Each member is emitted only when it resolves to an authored enrichment ability.
/detachment_rule_ids/*.reason: Each member is a joined named-rule → ability link, emitted only after enrichment resolution.

transforms.operation: Build base detachment points and faction-directory overrides.

filters: Match entities by slug and apply an override only for the resolved repository faction directory.
precedence: The matching detachment_faction_detachment_points_cost row overrides detachment.detachmentPointsCost; otherwise retain the base cost.
/detachment_points.reason: The reconciler and source-backed detachment seeder use the authoritative base cost plus scoped override.

transforms.operation: Slug English force-disposition names into repository ids.

filters: Use the association rows for the current detachment.
/force_dispositions.reason: Current tooling derives disposition references from the detachment association table.

transforms.operation: Slug an English force-disposition name into one repository id.

filters: Use the association rows for the current detachment.
/force_dispositions/*.reason: Each current disposition reference is derived from a verified association.

transforms.operation: Resolve the detachment's unique keyword(s) to labels and slug each into a mutual-exclusivity tag.

filters: For each matched detachment, replace the authored tag list with the exact sorted source-derived list; clear stale tags when the source derives none.
precedence: The current MFM unique-keyword relation is authoritative for matched detachments.
/tags.reason: The unique-keyword rows are GW's 'at most one detachment per shared tag' grouping; the reconcile derives the lowercase tag slug from them.

transforms.operation: Slug one unique-keyword label into a mutual-exclusivity tag.

filters: Emit each member of the exact source-derived tag list; remove members absent from the current source.
precedence: The current MFM unique-keyword relation is authoritative for matched detachments.
/tags/*.reason: Each mutual-exclusivity tag is the slug of one unique-keyword label.

transforms.operation: Derive a detachment-scoped enhancement id from the selected names.

filters: Only Combat Patrol enhancements selected while seeding a new Combat Patrol detachment.
/enhancement_ids.reason: Only the Combat Patrol seeder currently derives and writes enhancement links from MFM.

transforms.operation: Derive one detachment-scoped enhancement id from the selected names.

filters: Only Combat Patrol enhancements selected while seeding a new Combat Patrol detachment.
/enhancement_ids/*.reason: Only the Combat Patrol seeder currently derives and writes enhancement links from MFM.

/stratagem_ids.reason: Stratagem links are authored entity relationships; seed-detachments does not project them.

/stratagem_ids/*.reason: Stratagem links are authored entity relationships; seed-detachments does not project them.

transforms.operation: Populate restrictions.required_keywords from the sub-faction applicability lock; excluded_keywords and notes remain authored.

filters: Only required_keywords is projected; the object's other members stay authored.
/restrictions.reason: The restrictions object is partially projected: its required_keywords is derived from the chapter-lock applicability, while excluded_keywords and notes remain authored.

/restrictions/excluded_keywords.reason: Datasheet eligibility exclusions are not equivalent to the repository keyword restriction shape.

/restrictions/excluded_keywords/*.reason: Datasheet eligibility exclusions are not equivalent to individual repository keyword restrictions.

/restrictions/notes.reason: Restriction notes are authored prose and are not projected from MFM.

transforms.operation: Emit the sub-faction lock: applicability keywords narrower than the owning roster (ownership keyword absent, roster/umbrella keywords dropped).

filters: Fill-only: only a genuine sub-faction lock is emitted (applicability that narrows below the roster); roster-wide enumerations and umbrella broadenings yield none. A populated authored value that differs is surfaced for review.
/restrictions/required_keywords.reason: Applicability IS a required-keyword restriction precisely when it excludes the owning roster keyword — the chapter-lock case the transform isolates.

transforms.operation: Each required keyword is one narrowing sub-faction applicability label.

filters: Fill-only; a populated authored value that differs is surfaced for review.
/restrictions/required_keywords/*.reason: Each required keyword is one sub-faction applicability label narrower than the owning roster.

/granted_keywords.reason: Granted construction keywords are authored rules; current detachment tooling does not derive them.

/granted_keywords/*.reason: Granted construction keyword records are authored rules.

/granted_keywords/*/keyword.reason: The granted construction keyword is authored rather than projected from MFM.

/granted_keywords/*/max_selected.reason: Selection caps are authored rule semantics absent from the current projection.

/granted_keywords/*/to_keywords.reason: Granted-keyword target filters are authored rule semantics.

/granted_keywords/*/to_keywords/*.reason: Each granted-keyword target filter is authored rule semantics.

/unit_minimums.reason: Unit-minimum construction rules are authored; no current MFM projection derives them.

/unit_minimums/*.reason: Unit-minimum construction rule records are authored.

/unit_minimums/*/keyword.reason: Unit-minimum keywords are authored construction rules.

/unit_minimums/*/min.reason: Unit-minimum counts are authored construction rules.

/game_version.reason: Game version is repository release context, not inferred from dump metadata.

/game_version/edition.reason: Edition is repository release context, not inferred from dump metadata.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: Dataslate is repository release context, not inferred from dump metadata.

transforms.operation: Stamp matched Combat Patrol detachments with the Combat Patrol game-mode reference.

filters: Only detachment rows marked Combat Patrol.
/game_modes.reason: Current tooling only derives Combat Patrol mode; other mode context remains authored.

transforms.operation: Emit the Combat Patrol game-mode reference for a marked detachment.

filters: Only detachment rows marked Combat Patrol.
/game_modes/*.reason: Current tooling only derives Combat Patrol mode; other mode context remains authored.
